pr_summary: Add support for advanced TIFF export features including pyramidal layers and tiled storage. The fix extends TiffExportParams struct with four new fields: Pyramid (bool), Tile (bool), TileHeight (int), and TileWidth (int). These fields are passed to the underlying libvips C implementation in vipsSaveTIFFToBuffer to enable multi-resolution TIFF generation and tiled storage for efficient region reads.
patch_file_cues: vips/foreign.go - vipsSaveTIFFToBuffer function modified to pass pyramid/tile params to C
vips/image.go - TiffExportParams struct extended with Pyramid, Tile, TileHeight, TileWidth fields
test_file_cues: vips/foreign_test.go - Tests for image type detection including TIFF
vips/image_golden_test.go - Golden tests for image operations
platform_constraint_evidence: README mentions Windows users should use WSL/Ubuntu

No Windows-specific or macOS-specific code in touched files
notes: This is a Go project using CGO to wrap libvips C library. The fix adds TIFF pyramid and tiling support by extending TiffExportParams struct and passing values to the C layer. Tests require libvips-dev system package. The project uses Go modules for dependency management and Makefile for common commands. Platform is Linux-compatible; CI runs on Ubuntu.
